80+ Advanced Gutenberg Blocks. 100% Free.

NexoBlocks is a powerful and completely free Gutenberg block plugin that extends the native WordPress Block Editor with 80+ advanced blocks, forms, WooCommerce tools, navigation features, templates, custom fonts, responsive controls, and powerful design options.

Build landing pages, business websites, portfolios, blogs, online stores, and more ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â directly inside Gutenberg.

No separate page builder required. No coding required. No Pro upgrade required.

Every currently available block and feature in NexoBlocks is free to use.

Why Choose NexoBlocks?

NexoBlocks brings powerful website-building tools together in one complete Gutenberg toolkit.

  • 80+ free Gutenberg blocks
  • No Pro version required

NexoBlocks helps you build more with the native WordPress Block Editor.

Create:

SVG Library

Customize everything directly with the WordPress Block Editor.

Theme Style & Global Design Controls

Create consistent designs across your website with global styling controls.

Manage supported design settings including:

You can also save and export supported design presets.

Responsive Design Controls

Create layouts that work across every screen size.

NexoBlocks provides responsive controls for:

  • Desktop
  • Tablet

Customize supported block settings based on different device sizes without writing custom code.

Powerful Design Controls

NexoBlocks provides flexible design options to help you create unique layouts.

Supported controls include:

  • Colors & Gradients ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â Colors, gradients, and supported visual effects
  • Borders & Shadows ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â Borders, border radius, outlines, and box shadows
  • Custom CSS ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â Add custom CSS to supported blocks
  • Animations ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã¢â‚¬Â Entrance animations, hover states, and supported effects

sections.faq:
What is NexoBlocks?

NexoBlocks is a free Gutenberg block plugin that extends the native WordPress Block Editor with 80+ advanced blocks, forms, WooCommerce tools, navigation features, templates, custom fonts, responsive controls, and additional website-building functionality.

Are all NexoBlocks blocks and features free?

Yes. All currently available NexoBlocks blocks and features are free to use. NexoBlocks does not require a Pro upgrade to access its current block collection.

Are there any premium blocks locked behind a paywall?

No. The currently available blocks and features included in NexoBlocks are free to use.

Do I need coding skills to use NexoBlocks?

No. NexoBlocks is designed to work visually inside the WordPress Block Editor. You can build and customize layouts using block settings and controls without writing code.

Does NexoBlocks work with the default WordPress Block Editor?

Yes. NexoBlocks is built for Gutenberg and works directly inside the native WordPress Block Editor.

Do I need a separate page builder?

No. NexoBlocks extends Gutenberg with advanced blocks and website-building tools, allowing you to build directly inside the native WordPress editor.

How many blocks does NexoBlocks include?

NexoBlocks includes 80+ free Gutenberg blocks across multiple categories, including basic, content, media, interactive, navigation, forms, social, blog and post, integration, and WooCommerce blocks.

Can I build responsive websites with NexoBlocks?

Yes. NexoBlocks includes responsive controls that allow you to customize supported block settings for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Does NexoBlocks work with WooCommerce?

Yes. NexoBlocks includes WooCommerce-related blocks and tools for creating product grids, product sliders, product categories, product filters, mini carts, floating carts, checkout layouts, and account pages.

Can I create forms with NexoBlocks?

Yes. NexoBlocks includes a Form Builder that allows you to create and customize forms directly inside the WordPress Block Editor.

Does the Form Builder support spam protection?

Yes. The Form Builder includes supported spam protection features such as honeypot protection and Google reCAPTCHA.

Can I create a Mega Menu with NexoBlocks?

Yes. NexoBlocks includes Mega Menu functionality along with navigation menus, offcanvas menus, and breadcrumbs.

Can I disable blocks that I do not use?

Yes. Go to NexoBlocks ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ Ã¢â‚¬â„¢ Settings to enable or disable individual blocks based on your project requirements.

Does NexoBlocks support custom fonts?

Yes. You can upload supported custom font files, including WOFF, WOFF2, and TTF, and use them across supported NexoBlocks features.

Does NexoBlocks include templates?

Yes. NexoBlocks includes a template library with ready-to-use templates and block patterns to help you build websites faster.

Does NexoBlocks work with my WordPress theme?

NexoBlocks is designed to work with the WordPress Block Editor and should work with properly coded WordPress themes that support Gutenberg.

How do I report a bug or request a feature?

You can use the WordPress.org support forum or open an issue on the NexoBlocks GitHub repository.
